model: LogisticRegression over lexical-similarity features (TF-IDF cosine, token-set ratio, partial ratio, Jaccard)
note: Offline-safe stand-in for sentence-embedding cosine similarity; swap in a local sentence-transformers model for higher recall on paraphrased/translated titles without changing the API contract.
derivation: Threshold derived from precision-recall curve on held-out validation split of labeled synthetic NGO title pairs (operationalizes SBP Reg 6 SS4's similarity test).
